title: Totally Different Feel and Character
summary: Reviews describe the G70 as feeling notably different or like a new machine, but the direction of that change is not consistently clear from the sampled fragments.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the car feeling totally different, more luxurious or striking in appearance, and in one case harder to use due to non-user-friendly features.

limitations: All sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, so the overall direction of sentiment cannot be resolved from this topic.
The examples mix appearance, luxurious feel, overall vehicle character, and usability concerns rather than one clearly unified aspect.
The sample is small, so examples are insufficient to determine how consistently these impressions appear beyond the provided fragments.
